$comment: Round 3 of the 7050TX-64 unblock probes (DRAFT — NOT yet executed; prepared 2026-11-22 after
run 10, for the next supervised capture day). Rounds 1-2 (runs 7/9, DR-141) settled the VRF/BGP/
VXLAN/STP-mode-none grammar. This round asks ONLY the device questions the shipped screens now
carry as disclosures: the #88 `rapid-pvst` acceptance (DR-151's container-only-acceptance note),
the MST-region removal spellings `no instance <id>` / `no instance <id> vlan <ranges>` / `no name`
/ `no revision` (DR-155 captured them on cEOS-lab 4.28.14M only — rea-q1..q4, all aborted), and
the open-item-7 subinterface context form (`interface <name>.<vlan>`, never exercised on any
target; DECISIONS open item 7).
PROBE TEXT PROVENANCE (DR-141: no invented tokens): `spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst` is composed
byte-for-byte by the shipped screen (arista-webui/src/features/stp/stp-global-rules.ts
stpModeLine); `instance 1 vlan 100,110` and bare `no instance 1` are stpRegionInstanceLine /
stpRegionNoInstanceLine spellings; the quad `no instance 1 vlan 100,110` and `no name`/`no
revision` are the device-captured cEOS spellings (docs/evidence/unblock-grammar-ceos.json) — the
screen does NOT yet compose removals for name/revision, and a positive hardware answer is
exactly what would justify adding the arm. `interface {{SCRATCH}}.100` is the open-item-7 form
itself (assertInterfaceName, src/resources/interfaces.ts — the subinterface class the parser
refuses on principle, never on device evidence).
Every batch is allowCommit:false: stage -> record `show session-config diffs` -> ABORT. Nothing
reaches running-config; STP never reconverges; default forwarding is untouched (the 2026-11-15
authorization). Refusals (1002/1004) are recorded as answers and the loop continues (DR-134).
WHAT THIS ROUND CANNOT ANSWER: committed `rapid-pvst` reconvergence timing on this SKU (needs a
COMMIT — the probe lane's fence refuses committing any non-scratch line; that half belongs to the
screen's own confirm-gated product use, DR-149), and the MST-region reconvergence timing.
UNLIKE ROUNDS 1-2, THIS SPEC NEEDS THE SCRATCH PORT: batch unblock3-subinterface-context names
{{SCRATCH}}. Run with EAPI_SCRATCH_INTERFACE set to the proven-unused port (Ethernet33 was
verified unused in the 2026-11-21/22 persistence runs, DR-150/DR-158).
RUN (from the repo root, after the section-2 env chain in docs/HARDWARE-CAPTURE.md):
bash scripts/capture-unblock-hw.sh --spec3 --go ...   (dry run first, without --go)
or manually:
export EAPI_HW_SESSION_PROBE=1
export EAPI_HW_PROBE_SPEC=$PWD/arista-api-client/docs/hw-capture-unblock3.draft.json
export EAPI_SCRATCH_INTERFACE=Ethernet33
npm -w arista-api-client run test:live -- src/hw-session-probe.live.test.ts

batches.name: unblock3-stp-rapid-pvst
batches.question: does 4.28.13.1M accept `spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst` STAGED (abort-only)? The shipped #/stp/global screen offers this mode with a mandatory container-only-acceptance disclosure (DR-151); cEOS-lab 4.28.14M accepted the committed flip (DR-148, stp-mode-change.ceos.json). A stage-accept here retires the disclosure's first half; a 1002 makes the screen's refusal fallback the designed steady state. Text = stp-global-rules.ts stpModeLine verbatim

batches.name: unblock3-stp-mst-remove-bare
batches.question: does the BARE `no instance <id>` removal stage on 4.28.13.1M? cEOS rea-q2 (unblock-grammar-ceos.json) showed it nets the mapping line out of the region block; the shipped screen stages exactly this spelling per row (stp-global-rules.ts stpRegionNoInstanceLine). Shape: add-then-remove in one session — a 1002 at the removal line is a grammar refusal; a clean stage whose NET diff is empty means both lines were accepted and cancelled (the net-out itself is the container-captured half, not re-asked here). Aborted either way

batches.name: unblock3-stp-mst-remove-quad
batches.question: does the QUAD `no instance <id> vlan <ranges>` removal stage on 4.28.13.1M (cEOS rea-q1: stages identically to the bare form)? Recorded for completeness of the removal-spelling matrix; the screen stays on the bare form regardless

batches.name: unblock3-stp-mst-no-name-revision
batches.question: do `no name` and `no revision` each stage on 4.28.13.1M (cEOS rea-q3/q4 removed exactly their field)? The screen has NO name/revision removal arm today (DR-151: uncaptured spellings stay out) — a positive hardware answer is the precondition for adding one. Add-then-remove of both fields in one session (same refusal-vs-cancelled-net reading as unblock3-stp-mst-remove-bare); aborted

batches.name: unblock3-subinterface-context
batches.question: does `interface <name>.<vlan>` open a context on this unit (DECISIONS open item 7: subinterface forms were refused by assertInterfaceName on principle, never on device evidence; the slash-split class is already device-confirmed)? Staged on the declared scratch port's subinterface with a marker description; ABORTED — nothing applies. A 1002 at the opener is the answer the parser needs to stay closed; acceptance widens open item 7 toward PLAN's discriminated union
